assignment_algorithm_specification: sha256_commit_reveal_cluster_blocked_object_assignment_v1: verify SHA256(seed_reveal)==seed_commitment; canonicalize and hash eligible roster; derive stable cluster and object ranks from seed_reveal, protocol_profile_id, roster_manifest_id, effective_cluster_id, and canonical_object_id; allocate exact discovery and confirmation nominal object quotas without placing one effective cluster in both partitions; assign remaining eligible objects only to role-specific reserve pools; fail closed when exact quotas and cluster separation cannot both be satisfied
seed_commitment_timing: recorded before the eligible roster identity is known
seed_reveal_timing: after eligible roster freeze and roster_manifest_id creation; before assignment table generation
roster_manifest_rule: canonical CSV bytes sorted by canonical_object_id and bound to schema, provenance, eligibility, and effective_cluster_id
partition_independence_rule: no effective_cluster_id and no canonical_object_id may occur in both partitions
nested_row_rule: all rows and observations belonging to an assigned source object remain in its partition
